verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop/relay collaboration product like Buzz. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls. Self-hosting claims such as "No external services required" are adjacent deployment properties, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
